svg.title: TheGeekDogs
svg.desc: Not a logo and never rendered on a page: the empty chair's lamp cone, flat brass on the room's own ground, dark values hard-coded. It is repainted for the dark-first redesign — the ground is --void and the cone is --lamp — and the mark itself is unchanged, because the chair and its light are still what the site is about. No gradient (a two-stop gradient across 16 physical pixels is a smear), no corner radius (iOS and Android mask the tile themselves) and no prefers-color-scheme block (the tile is dark in both schemes, and a media query here would leave the vector and the three PNGs disagreeing). scripts/build-icons.mjs exports the PNGs from this file.
